checks.openings: Five windows, D1 door and N1 niche reviewed front/left/right with texture and clay. Recesses and mullions visible; no large duplicated frame strips. Source registration remains approximate.
checks.threshold: Shallow provisional threshold; no imported three-step assumption. Above and below views reviewed, no visible coplanar base flicker in sampled views.
checks.pipes: 3D pipes hidden in browser: no duplicate photographic pipe at checked corner. Locations remain provisional.

checks.materials: Final synthetic swatches replace visually failed protected composite. Four repeat sheets reviewed; periodic patterns remain visible at extreme close-up. No claims of original pixel preservation on generated facade.
checks.axes: Four texture axes, four clay axes and four roof corners reviewed. Rear/side blank envelopes intentionally undocumented, not historically verified.
checks.colour_resolution: Facade 1582x994; four repeating material tiles 512x512. Detail generated from low-information source, not measured archival resolution. Warm mineral colour provisional.
checks.bevel: Selected sills/threshold 8 mm and A profile 12 mm, three segments. Broad wall corners remain simple. No global smoothing of registered facade.
checks.lettering: No legible facade sign identified for this house; lettering from rejected FRONT not transferred.
checks.identity: Source dialog clicked in actual browser and screenshot reviewed; plan and overview identify low three-axis cp263 next to ornate262.
